NewsArticle.Title: Monk Master Requirements Changed
NewsArticle.Content:
After many requests from players and careful consideration of keeping things balanced, the requirements to become a Monk Master have been altered.
There are two types of Monk characters - ones that put all of their stat points into Str and Con, and those who also level up their other stats. For the more 'level' players, the Hit point and Mana requirements have been lowered.
Also, two new ways to check the skills Mastered have been added. One makes it easier if the character is a high level Dugon, the other requires mastering skills outside of the Monestary.
Hopefully this has made things more balanced for the Monks to become Masters.
